top.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
top.summary: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

topIndia.title: Taiwan's economy grows by almost 13% on AI demand
topIndia.summary: Taiwan's exports surged 21.6% year-on-year in the second quarter, which was "mainly driven by the sustained strong external demand for artificial intelligence (AI) and related evolving applications", the statement said. Imports over the same period grew by 18.3% from a year ago.
